quest.title: Farmland Fugitives
quest.description: The area around the Dawn Winery has also been invaded by Forest Boars, and Farabi, who is trying his best to look for Snowboar traces, seems to be poking around that same area today...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

talks.objective: Talk to Walter near Dawn Winery

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Here's some good news. Because people have found concrete evidence of the survival of Snowboars, I just received a letter from my mentor saying that my thesis has been approved.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, sounds like everything's going smoothly for you, eh? Congrats!

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: It's a good start, but the research that follows will take a long time, so I have to be prepared to stay in Mondstadt for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Next, I have to figure out how the Snowboars managed to leave the snowy mountains and ended up in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Based on the tracks that have been found, I'm guessing that they descended the mountain from its western face, passed Dawn Winery, and then made their way to Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: If this hypothesis is correct, we should be able to find traces of them in the area. So, our goal today is to investigate this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon gets it. Uh, also, who is this guy beside you? He looks all dressed for a hunt.

dialogues.speaker: Walter
dialogues.text: Hello, my name is Walter. Recently, I've taken up the responsibility of overseeing security near Dawn Winery.

dialogues.speaker: Walter
dialogues.text: Edmund told me that you guys are looking for Snowboars. Could you come with me today? I happen to need some extra hands to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Walter
dialogues.text: *sigh* Some Forest Boars broke into the nearby farms last night, scaring off all their pigeons and ducks. They still haven't found all of them.

dialogues.speaker: Walter
dialogues.text: Traveler, when we are hunting later, please capture these small animals when you find them and bring them back with you.

dialogues.speaker: Walter
dialogues.text: I heard that you know how to use hunting tools. I've got some around here too, so help yourself. We can set off once you're ready.

choices.text: Wait, I have other things to do.

response.speaker: Walter
response.text: Yeah, take your time. I'll be waiting right here.

talks.objective: Participate in the hunt near Dawn Winery
